bio: The beachside location is simply idyllic – you can't get much closer to the Baltic Sea! In this restaurant at the Weissenhaus Private Nature Luxury Resort, diners are shown to their tables in a modern interior with a glazed façade that affords fantastic views. But it is of course the terrace that is the top attraction! The food is a fresh blend of Mediterranean fare – somewhat simpler at lunchtime, more sophisticated in the evening, from classic dishes to elegant culinary compositions. Service runs from 1pm-4.30pm, reservation times in the evening are 6pm and 8.30pm....
